limitations: Task-local prototype only; it does not alter the production generator, canonical rule, catalog, or approval state.
source_action is limited to move and copy; bracket interpretation, destination alignment, colors, and transparent bitmap semantics remain unchanged.
The hidden setting is chosen once per episode and is not present in public challenge JSON.
The default move source is byte-for-byte canonical after outer whitespace is stripped; copy changes only the final source-erasure branch.
Evidence covers two retained episodes, one per setting, four query rotations per episode, and the single declared rival setting.
Finite rival checks establish the declared move/copy distinction only; they do not prove identification against arbitrary programs or training admission.

parameter.episode_scope: chosen once and fixed for all demonstrations and query
invariant_reasoning: identify the movable bitmap color and bounding box
use the same-side bracket for row alignment
use the opposite-side bracket interior for column alignment
copy only occupied bitmap cells transparently
parameter.name: source_action
parameter.varying_step: erase the source for move; retain it for copy

copy.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((sc (first (filter (lambda (v) (and (!= v 4) (!= v 7))) (grid-colors g))))
                (sp (find-color g sc))
                (bb (bbox-of-cells sp))
                (sr1 (first bb))
                (sc1 (second bb))
                (sr2 (third bb))
                (sc2 (fourth bb))
                (sh (+ 1 (- sr2 sr1)))
                (sw (+ 1 (- sc2 sc1)))
                (yobjs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 4)) (objects g 7)))
                (b0 (obj-bbox (first yobjs)))
                (b1 (obj-bbox (second yobjs)))
                (scc (/ (+ 0.0 sc1 sc2) 2))
                (mc (/ (+ 0.0 w) 2))
                (b0cc (/ (+ 0.0 (second b0) (fourth b0)) 2))
                (ci0 (not (= (< scc mc) (< b0cc mc))))
                (cb (if ci0 b0 b1))
                (rb (if ci0 b1 b0))
                (cbo (if ci0 (first yobjs) (second yobjs)))
                (cbs (map (lambda (p) (+ (* (first p) 1000) (second p)))
                          (obj-cells cbo)))
                (ic (filter (lambda (c)
                              (let loop
                                   ((r (first cb)))
                                   (if (> r (third cb))
                                       #f
                                       (if (not (member (+ (* r 1000) c) cbs))
                                           #t
                                           (loop (+ r 1))))))
                            (range (second cb) (+ 1 (fourth cb)))))
                (rbcr (/ (+ 0.0 (first rb) (third rb)) 2))
                (cbcc (/ (+ 0.0 (second cb) (fourth cb)) 2))
                (nr (if (> rbcr (/ (+ 0.0 h) 2)) (+ 1 (- (third rb) sh)) (first rb)))
                (nc (if (> cbcc mc) (+ 1 (- (max-list ic) sw)) (min-list ic))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (if (and (>= r nr) (< r (+ nr sh)) (>= c nc) (< c (+ nc sw)))
                        (let ((sv (at g (+ sr1 (- r nr)) (+ sc1 (- c nc)))))
                          (if (= sv sc) sc v))
                        v)))))
